terms.definition: The rate of flow of charge, I = ΔQ/Δt.
terms.examiner: The coulomb is one ampere second.

terms.definition: The charge on a proton, e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C; the electron has charge −e.
terms.examiner: Net charge on a particle is quantised: a whole multiple of e.

terms.definition: The sum of the currents into a junction equals the sum of the currents out of it.
terms.examiner: It follows from conservation of charge.

terms.definition: The average velocity of the charge carriers along a conductor, from I = Anev.
terms.examiner: n is the number density of charge carriers: large for conductors, smaller for semiconductors.
